### T-649 — Add the blob reference contract to `core/blong`

> _2026-11-14 · core/blong · done_

Planned in `plans/blob/plan.md`.

A new `core/blong/blob.ts` exporting `IBlobMeta`, `blobUriParse('blob://party/<key>')`,
`blobUriFormat`, and `blobScopeMatch(meta, scopes)`, with the `anonymous` and `authenticated` tokens
as constants (`BLOB_SCOPE_ANONYMOUS`, `BLOB_SCOPE_AUTHENTICATED`). Both the server realm and the
browser widget import this file, which is why it is here rather than in the realm (@@D-842).
`IBlobMeta` is the shape the store persists, field for field.
